shows.title: Lanterns
shows.overview: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

shows.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
shows.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There’s only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

shows.title: Marshals
shows.overview: With the Yellowstone Ranch behind him, Kayce Dutton joins an elite unit of U.S. Marshals, combining his skills as a cowboy and Navy SEAL to bring range justice to Montana, where he and his teammates must balance family, duty and the high psychological cost that comes with serving as the last line of defense in the region's war on violence.

shows.title: Aoashi
shows.overview: Ashito Aoi is a young, aspiring soccer player from a backwater town in Japan. His hopes of getting into a high school with a good soccer club are dashed when he causes an incident during a critical match for his team, which results in their loss and elimination from the tournament. Nevertheless, he catches the eye of someone important who happened to be visiting from Tokyo. How will things turn out for Ashito?

shows.title: Overgeared
shows.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

shows.title: Blue Box
shows.overview: Taiki Inomata loves badminton, but he has a long way to go before he can reach nationals. When Taiki sees upperclassman Chinatsu Kano practicing her heart out on the girls’ basketball team, he falls for her hard. After an unexpected turn of events brings the two closer together, sports might not be the first thing on their minds anymore!

shows.title: East of Eden
shows.overview: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

shows.title: GET JIRO
shows.overview: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

shows.title: The Apothecary Diaries
shows.overview: Maomao lived a peaceful life with her apothecary father. Until one day, she's sold as a lowly servant to the emperor's palace. But she wasn't meant for a compliant life among royalty. So when imperial heirs fall ill, she decides to step in and find a cure! This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she's making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!

shows.title: Coven Academy
shows.overview: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.
